title_zh: 联想：传达室里的创业故事
title_en: Chinese Companies (11/20): Lenovo, the Startup That Began in a Gatehouse
note_en: 才 before a verb means "only then, not until then," signaling that something happened later than one might expect: 后来才开始自己生产电脑 "only later did it start making its own." It often pairs with a time phrase introduced by 直到: 直到2009年，杨元庆才重新担任… "it was not until 2009 that Yang once again took over." English needs "not until" or "only then," while Chinese simply places 才 right before the verb.
